_README: Session-level TRAIN / VALIDATION / TEST allocation. The invariant this file
exists to enforce: every physical acquisition session belongs to exactly ONE
split. Overlapping windows from one session must never cross a split boundary,
because consecutive windows of a single continuous operator action are
correlated -- scattering them across splits lets a model see, in training,
windows that overlap the ones it is tested on.
Allocation rationale (recorded, not tuned):
20260902_171313 -> TRAIN. Largest operator-marked session (152 records,
4 phases). Highest-quality evidence, so it anchors the
learned normal region.
20260902_102448 -> TRAIN. label_source is transcript_reconstruction, the
weaker grade of evidence (RESULTS.md: reconstructed
resting peak p90 runs ~3x fatter). It belongs in TRAIN
precisely because it must NOT carry a reported result.
20260902_173108 -> VALIDATION. Operator-marked. Used for threshold
selection, fusion meta-training, and the self-loop sweep.
20260902_221217 -> TEST. Operator-marked, and the only session containing
graded fault_weak / fault_strong phases, so the untouched
test set is the one that can speak to detection floor.
TEST is untouched by model fitting, normalization, threshold selection,
hyperparameter tuning, fusion training, reward design, and model selection.
Enforced by tests/test_invariants.py::TestSessionSplit.
The 20260901_* sessions are absent by design, not oversight: they used the
old unpaced acquisition chain and sit on a different frequency axis
(CLAUDE.md, RESULTS.md 13.4c). They are excluded from every split.
